programme.title: The Bells Of Death
programme.desc: Amidst fountains of blood and guts, The Bells Of Death is a whirlwind story about a man embarking on a lifes journey to learn the sword, then gain revenge on the three men who killed his family and abducted his sister.

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: Chang Cheh directs an early incarnation of Ti Lungs lone swordsman in this kung-fu classic. King Eagle crosses blades with the Tongs after falling for Li Chings beautiful Chief.

programme.title: Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan must save the woman he loves (Li Li-hua), before she is presented as a gift to the General!

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: Two rival swordsmen, the heroic Fu Hung Hsieh and the wealthy Yen Nan-Fei, must team up to prevent the legendary Peacock Dart from falling into the hands of Mr. Yu and his evil criminal underworld. Traps, poisons, and double-crossings are everywhere in this spooky swordplay thriller from the Shaw Bros. Studio.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Action maestro Chang Cheh tells the story of Chin Feng, who meets the beautiful Ting Hung while on the run for accidentally killing an arrogant bully.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: A framed kung-fu master seeks revenge after 15 years in prison. He survives one attempt on his life after another! An intriguing, exciting production which weaves mystery and suspense with kung-fu action.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master named Shadow Whip, he is suspected and hunted.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: After suffering an out-of-the-blue seizure during a camping trip, female police officer May returns to active duty, only for bizarre happenings and death to follow her around.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Young Lin Hsiao-hung is a poor orphan. She seeks the help of her wealthy uncle, Fang Chen-chuan and his sons, Fang Cheng who is brave and honest, and Fang Feng, a playboy.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu (Ya Feng) head to HK, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: With the destruction of the Shaolin Temple, five students must each learn Shaolin techniques in order to defeat their Ching adversaries. But theres a traitor amongst them, but who is it?

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A probation officer tries to help a prisoner who faces harassment from corrupt guards and inmates.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: An award winning movie for best script and best editing. Another tale of a Sino-Japanese war that artistically and emotional triumphed, it clearly portrays the life of wartime.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns to defend the family homestead against Japanese financiers. Once back, Yen faces romantic complications as well as marauding, murderers villains.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun plays the replacement hired for a popular band whose egotistic drummer quit to join a rival group.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lous brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: A young and learned martial artist is tasked by the Qing emperor to spy on dissents in another province who plan to overthrow him. He infiltrates the rebel leaders large estate by becoming his granddaughters private live in tutor.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: An unparalleled kung-fu masterpiece from the one and only Chang Cheh. The dying Poison Clan master sends his last pupil on a dangerous mission to hunt down the five titular warriors.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Legendary actress Lin Feng Jiao stars in this romantic comedy as an unlikely romance occurs between an entrepreneurs son and a kindergartens principals niece.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: This tale of hidden treasure and a young wushu warrior in the Valley of Villains is considered among the best from director Chu Yuan and celebrated author Ku Lung. Making the production even more special is the presence of international favorite Alexander Fu Sheng.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70s Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang-lung both work as guards for the Tien Ying Treasury House, an establishment that offers its clients storage and safe transportation for their money or valuables.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: Two clans compete for dominance over the martial arts world in this classic of violent swordplay and political intrigue. A complex tale of deception and double crosses. Killer Clans leaves viewers guessing every step of the way. Masterful fight choreography from Yuen Cheung Yan (Yuen Clan member and brother of Yuen Woo Ping) and Tong Gaai fills the screen with bloody sword fighting and imaginative weaponry, delivering both great drama and fantastic martial arts.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Peng fought against many swordsmen and won, so he couldnt accept his first defeat and wanted to suicide. The Sect leader gives him the Full Moon Scimitar on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: George Lam Tsz-Cheung tries, along with his buddies Hamburger and Snoopy, to find love and success in the world of TV commercials.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: LIFE GAMBLE is the tale of a simple blacksmith (Kuo Chue) with extraordinary martial-arts skills who is entangled in a life-and-death struggle among swordsmen, thieves, con artists, a smooth dagger-slinger (Fu Sheng), a beautiful seductress (Lin Chen-chi) who can kill with her smile, a servant with a deadly whip, an assassin with a golden hairpin, an iron-fisted villain on a murderous rampage, a ruthless gambler with seemingly unlimited funds, and so many more.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hus stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: The evil minister uses the twelve golden medallions, the highest imperial decree, to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang wrote and directed Tales of Larceny, a story of scams and deceit during the corrupt Chinese Warlord era, featuring top character actors from Shaw Brothers roster.

programme.desc: A hired killer unknowingly makes friends with the man hes been sent to assassinate.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Rainbow
programme.desc: Set in Hong Kong in the 1960s, the story revolves around the family of a hardworking shoemaker Mr Law, with his happy-go-lucky wife and two sons – a talented elder son and an eight-year-old eccentric younger son. While their lives are not always smooth-sailing, the family sticks together and support one another through thick and thin.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds?

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Abandoned by her mother, Xiaofei, a positive and cheerful girl, encounters a "Wish Come True Machine" that can fulfil peoples wishes, and forms a bond with a young man named Wai who suffers from a rare disease.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it.

programme.title: Beyond The Dream
programme.desc: Primary school teacher Lok is a recovering schizophrenic who falls in love with a young girl he first met. As he struggles to reveal his illness, Lok has a relapse and becomes delusional. Little does he know she is a mental health counsellor who has a hidden agenda. The pair develops a relationship that is beyond their wildest dreams.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Knight Of Shadows: Yin and Yang
programme.desc: Pu Song Ling, a legendary demon hunter, is asked to investigate a case involving missing teenage village girls with Constable Yan Fei and accidentally discover a mysterious love between a knight and a female ghost.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar owner befriends a drunken woman and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: A former boxing champion and convict who has just been released from prison discovers that his wife has died and he is now a single parent. The situation is made worse with his daughters diagnosis of leukaemia.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack and Chuns boss is the mastermind of the attack. When Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight to prove his innocence in the cyber world.

programme.title: One Second
programme.desc: The film is set during the Cultural Revolution, where a common man escapes a labour camp to find a newsreel that captures his daughter for one second in a movie.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon 2
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: About three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost, a boy commits suicide, and some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes.

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Fok Kit is the hottest underground boxer with unbeatable records. To save their boxing studio from being sold, he must win the fight against Shaolin who is known as "Killing Machine". Fok Kit is defeated and badly hurt in the fight, which is a set-up by Lok, who wants to take revenge on Fok Kit’s master, Debo.

programme.title: Ready O/R Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Waters ex-girlfriend asked him to take care of their autistic son. As Water lives with his son, he discovers his sons talent in running, Water decides to give up his dissipated life and support his sons dream.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: Adventure Of The King
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor Zhengde flees the palace to see the world after his mother orders him to marry an ugly princess. He disguises as a commoner and escapes with his advisors, but a gambling mishap causes them to part ways and Zhengde lost all his money. Phoenix, the owner of Lung Fung Inn, takes him in out of pity, and thus begins his new adventure...

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the country’s energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: American Dreams In China
programme.desc: During the economic reform period in the 80s, three undergraduates are brought together by a common ambition, to live the American dream.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Love Is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, an intruder enters Bos house and takes her hostage. Then, she discovers her husbands secret which is related to her accident last year.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: An unknown film director who is pursuing his dream and unremittingly pursuing a career in film.

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: Ho Sau, an undercover agent, has been working with Yau, a drug lord, for years, but his job and family are in trouble.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Daily’s Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: The Great Ruins: Liangzhu,
programme.desc: What could this motif reveal about ancient Chinese civilization? What could these grains tell us about life thousands of years ago? And how did these prehistoric people tame ferocious floods? All the secrets are revealed in this documentary: "The Great Ancient Ruins: Liangzhu."

programme.desc: Primates, like lemurs, baboons, and monkeys, are our closest living relatives, making them a source of endless human fascination. See their adaptability and resilience in action through their daily quests for food and shelter.

programme.title: Coastal Africa
programme.desc: The southern tip of Africa features diverse ecosystems home to abundant wildlife, sustained by the convergence of two ocean currents along its coasts.

programme.title: Animals At Play
programme.desc: Young animals spend hours playing, but its a fact that has been ignored by science. A new research reveals that play is at the heart of almost everything an animal learns. It reveals how important is for animals to play with each other

programme.title: Hafizah
programme.desc: Since childhood, Hafizah ( Olivia Jensen ) has lived in an orphanage without knowing who her parents are. Many people like her simple, cheerful and tomboyish attitude. Unfortunately, on her 18th birthday, Hafizah had to leave the orphanage according to applicable regulations. Hafizahs life changed. He is invited to work at the house of Widuri ( Ade Irawan ), a rich grandmother who is known for being fierce and angry. Hafizahs outspoken attitude resulted in her often clashing with Widuri. Surya ( Ferry Salim ), Widuris son, and wife, Vani ( Cut Tari ), persuade Hafizah to feel at home working. In fact, its not only Widuri who has to be faced, but also Ryan ( Galih Ginanjar ), his grandson. Ryans reckless behavior causes them to often fight. Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.
